build_ReIDMetrics_mAP: build a ReIDMetrics evaluator to compute mAP for person re-identification using query and gallery features
build_ReIDMetrics_CMC: build a ReIDMetrics evaluator to compute CMC recall at ranks 1, 5, 10, 20 for re-identification
process_ReIDMetrics_batch: process a batch of predicted features and ground truth labels for re-identification evaluation
compute_ReIDMetrics_metrics: compute mAP and cumulative matching characteristics from collected re-identification results
review_ReIDMetrics_class: review the ReIDMetrics class that extends BaseMetric for mAP and CMC evaluation in re-identification tasks
